## Summary

- What changed and why?

## Verification

- Exact commands run and their outcomes.

## Security

- Auth, authorization/RLS, validation, secrets, PII/KYC, payments, uploads, webhooks, and dependency impact; write "Not applicable" with a reason when appropriate.

## Database / contracts

- [ ] Migration added or not applicable
- [ ] OpenAPI and generated TypeScript contracts updated or not applicable

## Review checklist

- [ ] Work is isolated on a task branch
- [ ] Diff contains no unrelated files or secrets
- [ ] PR targets the upstream default branch
- [ ] Human review complete
